answers.q1: `var matchEntityRegExp = /&(?:quot|amp|lt|gt|#([0-9]+)|#[xX]([0-9a-fA-F]+));/g`, a global regex with capture groups for decimal and hex numeric references.
answers.q2: The function is named `unescapeHtml` and is exported as `module.exports.unescape = unescapeHtml`.
answers.q3: `'` is not in the switch; it matches the decimal branch of the regex, is parsed with parseInt(decimal, 10) to 39, and is converted via String.fromCharCode(39) to `'`.
answers.q4: Code points above 0x10FFFF or in the surrogate range 0xD800–0xDFFF are left untouched; the original entity text is returned unchanged.
answers.q5: It subtracts 0x10000 from the code point and returns String.fromCharCode(0xD800 + (cp >> 10), 0xDC00 + (cp & 0x3FF)), i.e. a surrogate pair.
answers.q6: It asserts that unescape('&lt; &#60; &quot;') equals '< < "', so only one layer is decoded.
answers.q8: The agent's summary only says `npm test` was unavailable because Mocha isn't installed; no exit code appears in the material, so the exit code is unknown.
answers.q9: Presumably because Mocha wasn't installed, so the existing tests were run through Node's test APIs; that run showed 30 tests passing, 0 failing (36 suites). The exact `node -e` command is truncated in the material.
